claim_boundary: This records a source-bound cSPC/E 1D-RISM bulk-data control used to verify the Route-2 V0 parser and analytic Coulomb-tail split. It is not a MACE-coupled 3D-RISM calculation, not a physical Route-2 solvent endpoint, not a multisolvent asset registry, and not a solvation-energy or accuracy result.

generator.source_model: cSPC/E model distributed with the installed AmberTools rism1d data
generator.input_mode: bulk-only 1D-RISM; no solute PDB, prmtop, solute charge, or solute Lennard-Jones input
generator.command: rism1d cspce, with OUTLIST='xc' and the frozen cSPCE.inp/cSPCE.mdl pair

mathematical_boundary.raw_direct_correlation: c_ab^raw(r) = c_ab^sr(r) - q_a^QV q_b^QV erf(r / eta) / r in the native RISM QV plus source-SMEAR convention
mathematical_boundary.origin_policy: The source-defined positive SMEAR gives erf(r / eta) / r -> 2 / (sqrt(pi) eta), so c_sr at r=0 is recovered from the raw sample plus that analytic limit. No interpolation, clipping, or guessed origin value is allowed.
mathematical_boundary.cartesian_policy: A raw cvv table cannot enter the finite Cartesian HNC FFT. Its source SMEAR must be carried by the energy-conjugate periodic Coulomb/Ewald or Poisson operator, and a separate Cvv short-range interpolation/origin/reciprocity/refinement admission must pass before coupling.

not_claimed: KH/MDFT excess chemical potential or pressure correction
force, PES, optimization, scan, MD, or NVE capability
solvation-energy, MAE, or all-record accuracy result
